_about: Registries, allowlists and baselines for the critic gauntlet's checks (Round I). figures (P01): each tracked figure with its value, scope label, date and source; `match` finds an occurrence, `when` (within `window` characters) says the occurrence is this figure, and `label` must appear within the same window. claims (P02): facts stated at several sites; every `detect` match must sit inside a match of one of its `canonical` forms. uk_spellings (P04), absolutes (P11) and currency.status (P03) are the word and phrase patterns those checks look for; unsourced (P10) holds its figure pattern and the source names it accepts besides the Resource Index publishers. allow: legitimate exceptions (a cited title, a proper name, a quoted source), each with its reason; `phrase` or `regex` must cover the hit in its unit, and P08 entries name a source `label` and the title `words` it may carry that its resource's name does not. baseline: judgment items for the owner (status judgment, IDs I-D001 on; status accepted once the owner keeps a baselined item, as P13 reads baselines only) and deck items for the deck round (status DEFERRED-DECK); each entry names its file, the hit and a context that holds it, and must match exactly one occurrence, so a new occurrence still fires. text_units.cjs holds the matching rules. license (Round J) and deck_palette (Round K): see their own notes. current_version (Round M): the release version the app's header badge states; statics_check 21 reads it.

deck_palette._about: Round K. The C2 tokens the deck may use in any XML part (statics_check 19): the dark tokens of the app, the landing page and the diagram posters (backgrounds, surfaces, text, accents, team colors and tints), the on-accent dark, the ink black for shadows, and the app's maturity level tokens the slide 7 ladder uses.

license._about: Round J. The LICENSE pin (the sha256 of Public/LICENSE, which ships as LICENSE byte for byte; Round N retired the ship-date token with the notice's dated paragraph), the license-term patterns (case-insensitive), the allowances and the short notice. statics_check (15 to 17) and the export gate's LICENSE_TERMS group both read this entry, so the two scan with the same patterns and the same allowances. Each allowance names its files (private-tree names) and its exact text, and must be present exactly as pinned; a hit is allowed only inside that text. Each pattern carries a character class and each allowed text a JSON unicode escape, so that neither matches itself when the gate scans this file.
